message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && mkdir -p /tmp/obj && CFLAGS="-g -O0 -w -fno-sanitize=all" && n=0; fail=0; while read f; do
  out="/tmp/obj/$(echo "$f" | tr '/' '_' | sed 's/\.pi$/.o/')"
  if gcc $CFLAGS -c "$f" -o "$out" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then
    n=$((n+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $f"
    head -3 /tmp/err.txt
  fi
done < /tmp/pi_files.txt
echo "compiled: $n, failed: $fail"
